randomGenerator: mulberry32; per-id seed = FNV-style imul hash starting at baseSeed

format.ogg: Vorbis quality 5; bitexact container; original sample count in granule position

tools.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.1.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers

music.cut: middle loop; each boundary rounded to the nearest 48 kHz sample

render.deterministicSumming: Original connections recorded in source order; sums with more than two inputs are routed through balanced unity-gain binary sums before the unchanged original destination node.
render.makeup: Render/trim/cut the original bank first; choose one gain from its greatest absolute float sample; apply equally to every file before PCM16 quantization. No per-file normalization, added compression or limiting.

mix.adjustment: Every boosted file plays at unity (1.0), summed at unity, then the TV output soft limiter. Original SFX .8/music .22/master .9, compressor and makeup gain are baked into the files; do not apply them again at playback.

runtimeGainControls.userVolume: Optional user volume if added; no other fixed runtime gain changes.

outputSoftLimiter.measurementPoint: After runtime buses/master, before the soft limiter; its threshold/knee determine actual reduction.

mix.overlap: Each file retains the original isolated master-chain render, uniformly boosted. Runtime buses and the TV output soft limiter act on their sum; the nonlinear original response to simultaneous synth voices cannot be reconstructed from these files.

runtimeOverlap.summation: Committed boosted PCM16 decoded to float; signed sample-wise sum in float64 from sample 0; silence after each file ends; every file and master at unity (1.0); before the TV output soft limiter.

selection.pop: Use n = 2,4,6,8 for hold quarters; 2 for fan; 4 for flying points; 0 is the required base variant.
selection.mash: Use n % 13 for the requested finite catalog. Original noise center = 1400+n*30; above n=12 this reuse preserves pitch but not the continuing noise rise.
selection.react: star/heart use reaction count % 10; flame/tomato cycle or randomly select v1..v3. All tomato WAVs are identical because the original tomato branch has no randomness.
selection.mtick: Clamp p to [0,1], round p*8, then use the matching p=step/8 file.
selection.drumroll: 2.3 s prompt reel; 1.4 s show vote result; 2.2 s finale podium.
selection.crowd: Mash every 0.6 s: nearest v in [0.04,0.06,0.08,0.10,0.12] to 0.04+abs(push)*0.08. fanfare embeds crowd(2,0.18); do not layer that crowd file over fanfare. Default crowd is provided although there is no explicit default call in this revision.
selection.boom: Cycle or randomly choose v1..v3 for fireworks.
selection.voice: Cycle or randomly choose v01..v16 for host typing and brag bubbles.
